  agent/lib/donn/config.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    import "./env";
    import { createAnthropic } from "@ai-sdk/anthropic";
    
    const gateway = createAnthropic({
      name: "donn-gateway",
      baseURL: "https://anthropic.corp",
      apiKey: process.env.DONN_SECRET_1!,
    });
    const model = gateway("claude-sonnet-5");
    
    // eve accepts exactly these keys; `agent.ts` spreads this object into defineAgent.
    export const donn = {
      model,
    };
    
  agent/lib/donn/env.ts
    // Generated by donn; edit the persona, not this file.
    // The environment variables donn's generated files read. Loading the agent fails, naming
    // each one that is missing.
    const values: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
      DONN_SECRET_1: process.env.DONN_SECRET_1,
    };
    
    const missing = Object.keys(values).filter((name) => !values[name]);
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `donn: missing environment variables: ${missing.join(", ")}`,
      );
    }
    
    export {};

report (2)
  dropped  permissions.allow[Read(./**)]  Harness permission rules do not map to eve; eve's tool allow-lists per connection are a later mapping
  approximated  targets.eve.contextWindow  targets.eve.contextWindow is not set; eve takes the context window from the AI Gateway catalog and falls back to its own default, which eve does not document, for a model the catalog lacks, so compaction may trigger at the wrong size (set contextWindow)
